headline: Polymarket Launches Ultra-Short Crypto Contracts Amid US CFTC Scrutiny
summary: Polymarket introduced new Up/Down crypto contracts on its U.S. platform. The launch coincides with renewed scrutiny from the CFTC concerning compliance with 2022 onboarding terms.
why: Polymarket is a leading decentralized prediction platform. Scrutiny from the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission highlights regulatory risks facing crypto derivatives and event markets.
